tokens.name: vellum
tokens.usage: The page: transcript, overlays, composer, cards, save slots — every primary reading surface.

tokens.name: vellum-deep
tokens.usage: Recessed vellum: stat grids, allocation panels, award notices, the drop-cap box, hover wash on quiet buttons.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The desk behind the framed page. Holds only ink text (9.5:1 / 15.3:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Walnut-black ink: all story text and essential controls. 14.1:1 on vellum (Hearth) / 14.4:1 (Hearth by night); 12:1+ on every other surface here.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Faded ink: margin voice 'Narration', epithets, captions, roll summaries. 5.2:1+ on vellum, vellum-deep, npc-wash and sage in both themes.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary buttons, Rowan's name, the NPC speech rule, the drop cap, links and selected borders. As text 5.4:1+ on vellum, vellum-deep, npc-wash, sage.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text on an amber fill (primary button, active navigation item). 6.4:1 / 8.4:1.

tokens.name: walnut
tokens.usage: The navigation spine (a leather binding). In Hearth by night it is close to vellum (1.2:1), so the spine always carries a 1px gilt border.

tokens.name: on-walnut
tokens.usage: Text on the walnut spine. 11.2:1 / 12.1:1.

tokens.name: gilt
tokens.usage: Gold leaf — ornament only: page frame, double rules under scene titles, the flourish between scenes, drop-cap frame, corner stars. Never text, never the only boundary of a control. 3.7:1 / 7.9:1 on vellum.

tokens.name: oxblood
tokens.usage: Errors, failed requests and the (deferred) System voice — always beside words that state the problem. 5.6:1+ on vellum and vellum-deep.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Faint ruled lines: journal rows, overlay sections, the inset line around NPC speech. Decorative (≈1.3:1); a control's boundary is ink-muted.

tokens.name: candle
tokens.usage: Candlelight strip for the pending response status. Text on it is ink (12.1:1 / 10.1:1).

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: The player's own intention scrap — the one cool note on the page so the player's words stand apart from the story. Text ink (12.8:1).

tokens.name: npc-wash
tokens.usage: Warm wash behind NPC speech, with a 3px amber rule and an inset rule line. ink 12.8:1 / 13.1:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring only. 3.7:1+ on vellum, vellum-deep, canvas, candle. On the walnut spine (2.2:1 in Hearth) it sits outside a 2px on-walnut gap.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind the one open overlay.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Title screen and the campaign name. Once per screen.

styles.name: scene-title
styles.usage: SceneHeading — a new place or time. Sits over a gilt double rule.

styles.name: npc-name
styles.usage: An NPC's name in the transcript margin. Engraved capitals mark who is speaking.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels (ActionButton, Details, Close). Short words only; Cinzel is all capitals.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small headings inside panels: stat grids, notices, overlay sections, navigation title.

styles.name: story
styles.sample: Oren doesn't stop counting. The coins go into the box in stacks of ten.
styles.usage: Everything in the transcript — narration, NPC speech, Rowan's table talk. One family, so voices change without the type changing. Cap at measure-story.

styles.name: interface
styles.sample: I ask Oren for another week on the payment.
styles.usage: Player intentions, overlay body, status copy, form fields.

styles.name: interface-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside interface text: results, status headlines, field labels.

styles.name: voice
styles.usage: Margin voice for You and Rowan. 'Narration' uses the same size in regular italic, ink-muted.

styles.name: epithet
styles.usage: The italic line under a margin voice: an NPC's epithet, 'your DM', 'as James'.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Roll summaries, in-world time, saved-at, fact sources, field hints.

styles.name: drop-cap
styles.usage: The boxed decorative initial on the first narration of a scene (StoryEntry dropCap). Relative to story size.

spacing.note: 4px scale. space-2 for tight relationships, space-4 for component padding, space-5–space-7 between major regions.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: label to its marker glyph.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight relationships: label to content, button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Continued paragraphs from the same voice; inline gaps between sibling controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between replies inside one turn; component padding (entries, cards, composer).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between the player's intention and Rowan's replies; margin-to-text gutter in the transcript.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between major regions; story page padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between turns in the transcript; scene breaks, title screen.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Notes, scraps, NPC speech, inline Details button, drop-cap box.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, composer, navigation items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: reference-overlay panel.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Reserved for large framing surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The pending-status dots and the character monogram seal only.

shadow.note: Stacked vellum. Restrained on the page; strongest on the overlay.

tokens.name: shadow-paper-edge
tokens.usage: Player-intention scraps and the character card.

tokens.name: shadow-page
tokens.usage: NotebookPage lifting off canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: reference-overlay only.

layout.note: Reading and target constraints from DESIGN.md and EXPERIENCE.md.

tokens.name: measure-story
tokens.usage: Max width of narration columns (55–75 characters).

tokens.name: margin-label
tokens.usage: Width of the transcript's margin column, where each entry's voice is written (Narration, Rowan, You, an NPC's name). Collapses above the text when the story column is under 34rem.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum pointer target (WCAG 2.2). Applies to nav items, NPC names, the roll Details button and overlay close controls.
